name: Fickle Form
text:
You've learned to embody your mercurial nature, changing size to fit in better with mortal folk. You can spend 1 minute to become Small if you're Tiny, or vice versa. The transformation lasts until you use Fickle Form again.

---
Special If you have the pixie sprite heritage or another heritage that makes you Small, you can become Medium or Tiny if you're Small, and can become Small if you're Medium.
